translation.description: Besides births and deaths, migration is a key driver of demographic change, especially for a strategically-located country like Malaysia. Using granular data from the Immigration Department, this dashboard gives you insight into arrivals at our nation's borders. Where do visitors to Malaysia come from? How has that changed over time? Are there peak seasons for travelling? Dive in and find out!

section_1.title: Top 10 nationalities arriving in Malaysia
section_1.description: Ranked by number of arrivals, separately for male and female travellers. The share is the percentage of all male (or female) arrivals in the selected period.

section_2.title: How many people from {{ country }} are arriving in Malaysia?
section_2.title_ALL: How many foreigners are arriving in Malaysia?
section_2.description: Search for any country to see its arrivals over time. This data is only available at national level because movement between states is free and unmonitored in Malaysia.

section_3.title: Arrivals to Malaysia by continent
section_3.description: Monthly arrivals of foreign visitors, grouped by the continent of their nationality.

section_4.title: Arrivals to Malaysia from key tourism sources
section_4.description: The 9 countries with the most arrivals to Malaysia over the past 36 months ({{ start }} to {{ end }}), ranked from largest to smallest.
